title: Atlas: zone-based fog of war
description: Generic, any-system zone-based fog of war. Trace the rooms of a map, wire them together, and tokens hide and reveal per player as they move: no wall drawing, no light sources. Per-room In/Out/Through line of sight, doorways that block sight on one connection, blackout to hide a room from the table entirely, optional movement restricted to connected rooms, and stackable area effects (web/fire/smoke) that tint the room.
